name: (01) Thaumaturgy (Lure of Flames) — 1 Basic — Hand of Flame

system.description:
Dancing fire wreathes the thaumaturge's hand at a word, shedding light and turning an open palm into a searing weapon that the caster's own flesh and clothing never feel.

Invoking Hand of Flame takes one action, and the flame remains until you choose to snuff it out. Striking a foe with your flame-wreathed hand inflicts aggravated damage; you suffer no harm or inconvenience and may even wear gloves, which remain unaffected. It combines freely with powers such as Celerity and Potence. Should you set something else alight, that secondary fire can later burn you. Retest with Occult.
system.source: Laws of the Night Revised, Disciplines
